label: Positions 3-5 of the original phase in sequences that start with digit 3
explanation: Fires almost only during the original (input) phase at steps 3-5, peaking at t=4 (about 61% of activation mass), and mostly when the first original token is the digit 3 (93% of mass, 26x lift). Its input-token identity matters little. Magnitude goes up when certain letters came just before: prev_tok s or z (about 5x lift) and prev2_tok s or y. The top examples look like 3 . s z [X] or 3 . f z [X], and adding these preceding-letter conditions raises dev F1 from 0.43 to 0.56. It never fires in the copy phase, at t<3 or t>=6, and only weakly at the delimiter. The base predicate captures about 92% of dev activation mass but has low precision (0.28): most sequences that start with 3 do not activate it at these positions, and the extra gating by earlier letters could not be captured with a clean rule.
